scripts.build: npm run build -w @author-studio/core && npm run build -w @author-studio/cli -w @author-studio/mcp -w @author-studio/server && npm run build -w @author-studio/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @author-studio/core && npm run test -w @author-studio/core
scripts.author: node packages/cli/dist/main.js
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:live: npm run build && E2E_LIVE=1 playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.desktop:bundle: npm run build && npm run bundle -w @author-studio/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:bundle && npx electron packages/desktop/app
